He kept the note in the drawer with the logbook, proof that the long solitary nights had mattered to someone.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一个还没醒来的人。街灯仍亮着，光晕落在空荡的马路上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，带起一阵湿凉的风。便利店的灯是唯一的暖色，店员靠在柜台边打盹。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸汽从缝里钻出来。远处的高楼只剩轮廓，窗户大多黑着。天边泛起极淡的青灰，鸟还没叫，城市在这一刻属于清洁工和失眠的人，安静得能听见自己的脚步。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by doing a tiny bit of it, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n• Like looking inside nested boxes: open one box, and if there's another box inside, you open that the same way, again and again.\n• It stops when you reach the smallest case that needs no more opening, like an empty box."}
